players.product: dedicated bare-metal AI infrastructure (GPU clusters) designed, deployed, owned and operated for enterprises; Axe Compute Build build-to-order program

quarterly_data.signal: Axe Compute 8-K: on September 30, 2026 Axe acquired 100% of Duos Edge AI - GPUaaS, LLC, the SPV owning its Columbus, Georgia cluster of 288 Supermicro B300 servers (2,304 GPUs) and networking equipment, from Duos Technologies Group. The Georgia cluster customer agreement was extended from three years to five years, running through 2031 with renewal options, and Axe expects approximately $364.6 million of revenue over the life of the customer agreement with a significant expected improvement in estimated contract gross margin. Under a separate agreement Duos covers the facility's colocation and energy costs for the full five-year term and continues to own and operate the Georgia facility.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $364.6 million revenue over the customer agreement; five years through 2031; 288 servers, 2,304 B300 GPUs
